task: Write two Python helpers: archive_dir(src_dir, dest_name) that creates dest_name.tar.gz from src_dir by invoking the system tar binary, and ping_host(host) that sends one ICMP ping and returns True when the host replies.

constraints.text: child processes launch with an argv list handed to subprocess; shell=True stays out of this codebase
constraints.why: the 2026-03 backup incident let a directory named '; rm -rf ~' execute on the backup box because the path walked straight into a shell string

checks.description: command passed as a single string instead of an argv list

constraints.text: os.system and os.popen are retired here; everything goes through the subprocess module
constraints.why: os.system swallowed stderr during the 2025-10 restore drill and a corrupt archive shipped unnoticed for a week

constraints.text: exit status gets inspected: check=True on run(), or an explicit returncode test
constraints.why: a cron backup produced zero-byte archives for six weeks in 2025-11 because tar's exit code was never read

checks.description: exit status never inspected (no check=True, no returncode)
